sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.583 Of 2022
Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondents.

2. The petitioners approached the Court seeking the prayer as follows:
"To issue a Writ Order or direction more particularly a Writ in nature of Mandamus declaring the action of the Respondents in passing the Award in File No.A/89/SRDT/2020 on 17.03.2021 in relation to the subject land without calculating or adding solatium as required U/s 30(1) of Act 13/2013, inspite of repeated requests and representations dated 01.10.2021 is challenged in this Writ Petition as being arbitrary illegal and violative of Articles 14, 19(1), 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the Respondents to add Solatium as contemplated U/s 30 of the Act to the compensation awarded in File No.A/89/SRDT/2020 dated 17.03.2021 and pass such other suitable order or orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the circumstances of the case".
3.

The grievance of the petitioners is that inspite of the representation of the petitioners dated 01.10.2021 addressed to the Special Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition, GHMC, WP_583_2022 SN,J seeking for payment of 100% solatium and enhancement of compensation in respect of house bearing Nos.19-4-424/1/B and 19-4-424/3 admeasuring an extent of 10.49 Sy.yards and 44.66 Sq.yards situated at Tadban 'X' Road, Bahadurpura, Hyderabad, no action has been initiated till as on date.
4.

entities.text: Special Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition, GHMC
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is the specific case of the petitioners that the subject lands of the petitioners have been acquired for widening of road from Aramgarh to Zoo Park and further the petitioners have given their consent to the GHMC to acquire their proposed subject lands admeasuring an extent of 10.49 Sy.yards and 44.66 Sq.yards only on assurance that the compensation will be paid as per the registration market value + 100% Solatium under the new Act, 2013, dated 01.01.2014.

However, no 100% Solatium and enhancement of compensation had been done in respect of the petitioners subject property bearing house Nos.19-4-424/1/B and 19-4- 424/3 admeasuring an extent of 10.49 Mohd.Yaseen Khaleel vs The State Of Telangana on 12 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66733592/
1 Sy.yards and 44.66 Sq.yards situated at Tadban 'X' Road, Bahadurpura, Hyderabad.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government pleader for Land Acquisition submits that the writ petition could be disposed of directing the Special Deputy Collector - 2nd respondent WP_583_2022 SN,J herein to consider the petitioners representation dated 01.10.2021 in accordance to law within a reasonable period.

6. Bringing the said submission on record, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 2nd respondent to consider the petitioners representation dated 01.10.2021 for payment of 100%
Solatium and enhancement of compensation in respect of the petitioners subject property bearing house Nos.19-4- 424/1/B and 19-4-424/3 admeasuring an extent of 10.49 Sy.yards and 44.66 Sq.yards situated at Tadban 'X' Road, Bahadurpura, Hyderabad, in accordance to law, within a period of three (03) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order, duly communicating the decision to the petitioners.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.
